review_candidates.description: Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble! Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. The Opportunity: SharePoint Administrator with Microsoft 365 Support I. Role Summary Ensures the stability, security, and efficiency of the SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment supporting healthcare revenue cycle operations. Administers collaboration and content platforms that enable accurate data processing, secure information sharing, and compliance with healthcare regulations. Contributes to operational continuity by maintaining service performance across SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and Exchange Online, and by resolving technical issues promptly. II. Competencies Valuing Differences – Works effectively with individuals of diverse cultures, interpersonal styles, abilities, motivations, or backgrounds; seeks out and uses unique abilities, insights, and ideas. Considers the collective. Collaboration – Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It’s “All for One and One for All.” Accountability – Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed. Someone who is willing to step up and own it. Time Management – Effectively manages personal time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently. Developing Trust – Gains others’ confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges. Takes Initiative – Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly. Problem Solving / Analytical Thinking – Diagnoses root cause of technical issues, evaluates options, and applies sound judgment under time pressure. Customer Focus – Understands business and end-user needs, communicates technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and delivers responsive service. III. Essential Job Functions Platform Administration Provide administration and technical support for M365 SharePoint Online, SharePoint on-premises, and Microsoft Teams environments. Manage and maintain site content and structure settings, site hierarchy, and site collection navigation. Manage site collections and subsites in SharePoint Online per approved service requests. Configure and administer SharePoint and automate recurring administrative tasks. Help define and build Microsoft Teams administrative procedures. Support OneDrive for Business sync issues and troubleshoot related user-side problems. Test and implement new features in the SharePoint on-premises environment prior to production release. Information Architecture and Reporting Design, configure, manage, and maintain site collection, site, and list-level usage reports and usability analysis. Help design, configure, and maintain enterprise taxonomy, terms, and keywords for the term store. Allocate additional storage quota to site collections as they approach the default maximum storage limit, and monitor tenant storage consumption against targets. Security, Identity, and Compliance Administer permissions models, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 group membership, and external/guest sharing controls in alignment with least-privilege principles. Assist with and monitor SharePoint related sensitivity labels, retention labels and policies, DLP rules, and information barriers to protect PHI and other regulated data in accordance with HIPAA and internal policy. Remediate oversharing, orphaned sites, and inactive workspaces through recurring review cycles; support eDiscovery, legal hold, and audit log requests. Governance and Lifecycle Recommend and implement governance techniques for Microsoft Teams and SharePoint environments. Collaborate with the M365 Administrator and peers to establish governance processes for Microsoft Teams. Execute site provisioning, ownership assignment, archiving, and decommissioning workflows, including standard user notifications prior to archive or deletion actions. Maintain versioning constraints and site quota standards as foundational administrative guardrails. Automation, Migration, and Continuity Develop and maintain PowerShell (PnP, SharePoint Online Management Shell, Microsoft Graph) scripts to automate reporting, bulk permissions changes, and lifecycle actions. Build and support Power Automate flows and Power Apps solutions built on SharePoint lists and libraries. Plan and execute content migrations and tenant-to-tenant or on-premises-to-cloud moves using approved tooling. Execute backup, retention, and recovery procedures for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 content to protect critical data and minimize downtime. Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and message center advisories; assess impact of upcoming changes and communicate to stakeholders. Support and Documentation Work tickets and service requests for SharePoint Online, M365 Enterprise SharePoint, and on-premises environments, meeting SLAs in the ITSM system. Troubleshoot issues and provide end-user support across SharePoint Online, M365 Enterprise SharePoint, and on-premises environments. Update documentation and verify the validity and accuracy of documentation used by end users, site owners, and administrators. Maintain change records and configuration documentation to ensure audit readiness; follow enterprise change management processes for production changes. Collaborate with internal teams to support content management needs and resolve technical challenges. Deliver end-user enablement and adoption guidance for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 applications. Participate in on-call rotation and after-hours maintenance windows as required. IV. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Three to five years administering SharePoint in an enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience with Microsoft 365 admin centers, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Teams administration, and PowerShell scripting. Working knowledge of ITSM/ticketing processes and SLA-driven support delivery. Experience in a HIPAA-regulated or other highly regulated environment preferred. This position pays between $76,300 and $114,450 based on experience. V. Certifications Required MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert — tenant administration, identity, security, and compliance; the core credential for this role. MS-900: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals — baseline platform knowledge; expected if MS-102 is not yet held. Preferred SC-400: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate — sensitivity labels, DLP, and retention, directly relevant to PHI and HIPAA obligations. SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator Associate — Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and permission governance. MS-700: Teams Administrator Associate — Teams-connected SharePoint sites and collaboration workloads. AZ-104: Azure Administrator Associate — useful where SharePoint integrates with Azure services and automation. PL-900: Power Platform Fundamentals — supports Power Automate and Power Apps solutions built on SharePoint. Job Description Job Summary The Analyst, Client Monitoring & Operations provides 24x7 support through a shift-based model to ensure continuous monitoring and operational support across critical payment processing platforms, services, and client-facing solutions. This role is responsible for proactively identifying potential issues, performing initial technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to mitigate service impacts and drive timely resolution. The analyst serves as an early detection and response point for operational incidents, helping maintain service stability and an exceptional client experience. The ideal candidate is an articulate and technically curious professional who can quickly assess issues, investigate complex situations, and collaborate effectively across teams. Successful candidates possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, a customer-first mindset, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment Key Responsibilities Provide 24x7 monitoring of transaction processing, platforms, services, portals, and settlement operations. Proactively identify, investigate, and communicate potential service disruptions before they impact clients or business operations. Perform initial technical troubleshooting, issue triage, and root cause analysis to determine the source and severity of incidents. Monitor system health, operational performance, alerts, and key indicators to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks. Engage with clients and internal stakeholders regarding ongoing incidents, service impacts, and resolution progress. Assess incident severity and determine appropriate escalation paths. Coordinate with technical, operational, product, and support teams to facilitate rapid issue resolution and service restoration. Execute established operational procedures and support processes while meeting defined service levels and performance metrics. Document investigations, findings, resolutions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement efforts. Utilize Visa tools, monitoring platforms, and operational dashboards to support daily monitoring and incident management activities. Identify opportunities to improve monitoring capabilities, operational processes, and incident response effectiveness. Experience in troubleshooting Microsoft Windows 7/10, Mac, Mobile Devices (Android & iOS), Microsoft Office applications suite, Office365, MS Exchange, Outlook, local and LAN printers, Wi-Fi, VPN, Internet Connectivity, Communication tools (Skype, Jabber, etc.). Experience in Microsoft Active Directory Users and Groups management. Experience in customer service and analytical skills. Experience in interacting effectively with customers, vendors, peers, and management via multiple communication channels. Experience in problem-solving and decision-making. Experience in completing at least two years of college education or equivalent IT/technical training. CompTIA A+ or Microsoft Professional Certification a plus. Preferred Qualifications 5 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD). Experience in supporting end users of Corporate IT services and applications. Experience in one or more supported domains or technologies (e.g. MS Exchange, System Administration, Business Application Support, MDM, etc.). Experience in continual service improvement and problem management activities. Experience in knowledge base article maintenance. Minimum four years of work experience as IT Service Desk analyst supporting end users of Corporate IT services and apps.
